passages.provision_quote: A municipality with a population of more than seventy-five thousand persons shall adopt regulations that allow on any lot or parcel where a single-family dwelling is allowed all of the following: 1. At least one attached and one detached accessory dwelling unit as a permitted use.
passages.note: Prints the ADU mandate/deregulation text Carbone sponsored; per the housing annex a law voiding local zoning limits is on-question but direction-only.
Lists Carbone as Prime sponsor of HB 2720 (2024), signed by the Governor 2024-05-21.
Carbone voted Y on House final reading of HB 2720 (2024), which passed 35-22-3-0-0.

rows.reasoning: As prime sponsor ("Carbone (Prime)") and with a Yea vote ("CARBONE Y", "Passed 35-22-3-0-0") on HB 2720 (2024), Carbone acted to require municipalities over 75,000 population to permit accessory dwelling units and to bar numerous local restrictions on them. This pushes in the direction of rung 5's clause to 'cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building,' but per the housing annex a deregulation law of this kind is on-question only in direction: it cannot show rung 5's 'at most' ceiling, since someone on rung 3 or rung 4 could vote for it too. No passage separates the rungs, so the row is BLANK direction-only.
